data_objects.name: jurisdiction_vaccination_timeseries
data_objects.meaning: Daily jurisdiction-level COVID-19 vaccination totals, person counts, population-normalized rates, vaccine products, and source attribution.
data_objects.notes: Blank cells represent measures not reported or not available for that jurisdiction-date observation.

variables.name: country
variables.meaning: Country or named jurisdiction represented by the time series.

variables.name: iso_code
variables.meaning: ISO-style jurisdiction code when available; some subnational jurisdictions have no code in this field.

variables.name: date
variables.meaning: Calendar date of the vaccination observation in ISO date format.

variables.name: total_vaccinations
variables.meaning: Cumulative vaccine doses administered by the observation date.

variables.name: people_vaccinated
variables.meaning: Cumulative people who have received at least one vaccine dose by the observation date.

variables.name: people_fully_vaccinated
variables.meaning: Cumulative people reported as fully vaccinated by the observation date.

variables.name: daily_vaccinations_raw
variables.meaning: Raw reported number of vaccine doses administered for the date.

variables.name: daily_vaccinations
variables.meaning: Processed daily vaccination count distinct from the raw report; the processing method is not supplied.

variables.name: total_vaccinations_per_hundred
variables.meaning: Cumulative vaccine doses administered per hundred people.

variables.name: people_vaccinated_per_hundred
variables.meaning: People receiving at least one dose per hundred people.

variables.name: people_fully_vaccinated_per_hundred
variables.meaning: People reported fully vaccinated per hundred people.

variables.name: daily_vaccinations_per_million
variables.meaning: Processed daily vaccine doses administered per million people.
variables.unit: doses per million people per day

variables.name: vaccines
variables.meaning: Comma-separated set of vaccine products reported as in use for the jurisdiction.

variables.name: source_name
variables.meaning: Name of the reporting organization or source.

variables.name: source_website
variables.meaning: Web address identifying the reported data source.

structure.description: Each row is a jurisdiction-date observation, and country together with date is the natural candidate key; rows form repeated daily time series by jurisdiction.
Total fields are cumulative states, daily fields are date-level flows, and per-hundred or per-million fields are population-normalized forms aligned to the same observation.
vaccines is a multi-valued categorical field, while source_name and source_website provide provenance that can repeat across dates.

uncertainties: The processing or smoothing method used for daily_vaccinations is not documented.
The criteria for full vaccination, population denominators, reporting cutoffs, and treatment of multi-dose regimens are not supplied.
The country field includes some subnational jurisdictions without iso_code values, so iso_code alone is not a complete grouping key.
annotation_notes: Only the declared train.csv and its neutral packet were used as evidence.
